subject: Banking handoff + PO payload acceptance — Acme Logistics
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <ops@acmelogistics.com>
Cc: contracts@acmelogistics.com
Date: Wed, 25 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Banking info + PO mapping

Hi Alex,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process. To get payments flowing for the pilot engagement, can you confirm the following by EOD so Finance can run the verification: 

- Signed bank details for both ACH and wire (routing + account + beneficiary name + bank SWIFT for wires)
- W-9 or VAT registration (depending on entity)
- Preferred remittance format (sample invoice-to-PO mapping)

Attached is our onboarding form to make this quicker — please fill the bank section and return (acme_onboarding_form.pdf). If you prefer, you can upload the completed form to the secure link in the HubSpot deal (I'll paste a link after we confirm).

A couple of notes on PO/Invoice mapping we need to lock down: 
- PO ID will be sent in the invoice metadata field named: rdw_po_id
- Invoice number needs to be in invoice_id
- For remittance we prefer a single CSV string per payment: PO|INVOICE|AMOUNT (example: PO-457|INV-334|3200.00)

Once we have your banking proof we will schedule two micro-deposits (USD) to validate the account — those typically clear in 2–3 business days. After micro-deposit verification, Finance will accept the bank and enable the account for live rails.

Attachments: acme_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable PDF)

Thanks — looping in Finance for visibility.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Ben —

Thanks, attaching the completed onboarding packet and signed bank detail page. We returned the filled form and the bank authorization: acme_bank_details_signed.pdf.

Key points:
- We can accept the remittance CSV string you specified. Sample below (this is how our accounting system labels remits):
  Invoice:PO-457|INV-334|3200.00
- We prefer ACH for recurring payments; wire for one-off high-value settlements.
- Micro-deposits: please send two amounts; we will confirm the cents amounts once received and then provide sign-off.

We are OK with the PO field rdw_po_id but will need the invoice_id to be exact match to our invoice number (no prefixes added).

Attachments: acme_bank_details_signed.pdf (scanned bank letter), completed onboarding form (pdf)

Thanks — I cc'd our contracts mailbox in case they need to review payment terms.

Best,
Alex Kim

ops@acmelogistics.com

Alex — thanks for the fast turnaround and the signed bank doc. Received acme_bank_details_signed.pdf.

Marissa / Priyom — taking action items for Finance/Payments: please prepare to schedule micro-deposits to the account detailed in the attached doc. Marissa, when you run the verification, please note the two amounts here so we can confirm with Acme. Priyom, please pre-provision the vendor in the payee registry with the rdw_payee_ref "ACME-457" and set rails: ACH preferred, wires enabled as fallback.

Attached is a draft PO payload mapping (po_payload_mapping_v1.xlsx) that shows how your invoice fields should map to our system. Highlights:
- rdw_po_id <- PO_NUMBER (string)
- invoice_id <- INVOICE_NO (string)
- payment_remit_string <- CONCAT(PO_NUMBER, "|", INVOICE_NO, "|", AMOUNT)
- remit_email <- billing@acmelogistics.com (used for delivery notifications)

Next steps for Alex/Acme:
1) Confirm you'll report the micro-deposit amounts back to this thread once they land.
2) Accept the PO payload mapping doc and flag any field name mismatches.
3) Contracts to confirm terms if any final redlines exist (cc'd).

Attachments: po_payload_mapping_v1.xlsx (mapping sample)
